tasks.title: Essay: Digital study tools in schools
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: In your English class you have been discussing digital study tools. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.
Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.
Some schools now provide digital study tools such as online textbooks and learning apps. What is the most important issue to consider when introducing these tools?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
listItems: 2. effect on concentration and study habits

tasks.title: Review: A digital study tool
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted!
paragraphs: Have you used a digital study tool recently – for example, a flashcard app, a note-taking platform or an online quiz site?
Write a review of the tool for our college website. Describe what it does, say how effective it was for your learning, and explain whether you would recommend it to other students.
The best reviews will be published on the website.

tasks.title: Article: Digital study tools and responsibility
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: How can students use digital study tools responsibly?

Write an article for our programme coordinator's website. Suggest one way students can avoid over-reliance on digital tools, explain how this could improve their learning, and describe the benefits for their long-term study skills.
We will publish the best articles on our website.

tasks.title: Email: Digital study tools query
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Digital study tools at your school
paragraphs: I heard your school has started using digital study tools in some subjects. I'm thinking of suggesting a similar approach at my school.
Can you tell me which tool you find most useful and why? Also, what problems have you experienced with digital tools? And how could we convince teachers who prefer traditional methods?

tasks.scenario: Essay: Discussing the most important issue when introducing digital study tools in schools

tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Unique scenario: not a generic 'should schools teach' essay. Uses specific notes about access and concentration. No overlap with previous tests.

tasks.scenario: Review: A digital study tool (e.g., flashcard app, note-taking platform)
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Unique: not a book review, library review, or event review. Focuses on a specific digital tool. No overlap with previous tests.

tasks.scenario: Article: How to use digital study tools responsibly
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Unique: not a generic 'learning beyond lessons' article. Focuses on responsibility and avoiding over-reliance. No overlap with previous tests.

tasks.scenario: Email: Replying to a friend asking about digital study tools at your school
tasks.purpose: explain a position and request arrangements
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Unique: not a 'course advice' or 'weekend job' email. Focuses on digital tools and convincing teachers. No overlap with previous tests.
